cards.text: Pull up a stool, friend, because this one's a big one. Some time later, God tests Abraham, Isaac's father, and calls out his name. "Here I am," Abraham answers.
God tells Abraham to take his son, his only son Isaac, whom he loves, and go to the land of Moriah. There, on one of the mountains, God tells him to offer Isaac as a burnt offering.

cards.question: God tells Abraham to make the offering on one of the mountains. True or false: God lets Abraham pick the mountain himself.
So Abraham gets up early the next morning, saddles his donkey, and takes two of his servants and Isaac along. What else does Abraham do before he sets out?

answers.text: He splits the wood for the offering
He fills jars with water for the trip
He packs gifts for the long trip

cards.text: They set out for the place God had designated, and on the third day Abraham sees it in the distance. I bet those three days felt long.

cards.question: Abraham tells his servants to stay there with the donkey. True or false: he says he and the boy will go over there to worship, and then come back to them.
Now it's just father and son. Abraham places the wood for the burnt offering on Isaac, and he carries the fire and the sacrificial ___ himself.

cards.text: The two of them walk on together, until Isaac speaks up: "My father!" "Here I am, my son," Abraham replies.

cards.question: Isaac looks around. The fire is here, and the wood is here. What does Isaac ask his father about?

answers.text: Where the lamb for the offering is
How much farther they have to walk

cards.question: Isaac's question about the lamb hangs in the air. What does Abraham tell his son?

answers.text: God Himself will provide the lamb
The servants will bring one up
We'll find one at the top

cards.text: And then, that line again: the two of them walk on together. I bet every step feels heavier now.

cards.question: Abraham and Isaac arrive at the place God had designated. There, Abraham builds the ___ and arranges the wood.

cards.text: Then he binds his son Isaac and places him on the altar, atop the wood.
Then Abraham reaches out his hand and takes the knife to slaughter his son. Friend, this part is heavy.
JUST THEN, the angel of the LORD calls out to Abraham from heaven: "Abraham, Abraham!"

cards.question: When the angel of the LORD calls, Abraham answers with the exact same words he gave God at the very start of this story. True or false?
Abraham has the knife in his hand and Isaac is on the altar. What does the angel of the LORD tell him?

answers.text: Do not lay a hand on the boy
Take the boy home with you

cards.question: The angel tells Abraham that now he knows Abraham ___ God.

cards.text: The angel says why he knows: Abraham has not withheld his only son. Okay, friend, go ahead and exhale, because my mustache has been clenched this WHOLE time.

cards.question: Then Abraham looks up. What does he see in a thicket behind him?

answers.text: A ram caught by its horns
A goat tangled in the vines
A calf stuck in the brush

cards.question: Abraham takes the ram and offers it as a burnt offering in place of his ___.

cards.text: Abraham calls that place The LORD Will Provide. And when this was written, people were still saying, "On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided."
Then the angel of the LORD calls to Abraham from heaven a SECOND time, and the LORD swears an oath.

cards.question: The LORD swears an oath to bless Abraham, because he has not withheld his only son. True or false: the LORD swears this oath by the heavens.
Swearing by Himself, the LORD says He will multiply Abraham's descendants. Like what?

answers.text: The stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore
The fish in the sea and the birds in the air
The trees in the forest and the grass in the field

cards.text: And his descendants will possess the gates of their enemies. Friend, back when I was stuck in the back of a junk drawer, I couldn't even possess my own corner.

cards.question: The LORD's promise keeps going, because Abraham obeyed His voice. True or false: the LORD says all nations of the earth will be blessed through Abraham's offspring.

cards.text: Abraham goes back to his servants, and they set out together for Beersheba, where Abraham settles. After a day like that, I'd be lying face-first in the chocolate chips for a week.

Some time later, Abraham gets news about his brother Nahor's family. Nahor's wife Milcah (Genesis 11:29) has borne him eight sons, and his concubine Reumah bears him four more children. One of Milcah's sons, Bethuel, becomes the father of Rebekah.
Abraham's not done yet, friend, and neither is his story.
